items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Closes Record IPO Raising ~$93.5 Billion with Full Greenshoe Exercised
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 完成史上最大 IPO，行使完整超額配售籌集約 935 億美元
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, Anthropic announced the closing of its IPO of 1.127 billion Class A shares at $83 each, including full exercise of the underwriters’ 147 million share option. The company received about $91.6 billion; a concurrent private placement of Class N shares to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA and TSMC raised an additional ~$26 billion.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 20 日，Anthropic 宣布完成 IPO 收盤，合計發行 11.27 億股 A 類股、每股 83 美元，並全數行使承銷商 1.47 億股超額配售權。公司收到約 916 億美元；同時向 AMD、Broadcom、Google、Micron、Microsoft、NVIDIA 與 TSMC 私募約 260 億美元 N 類股。
items_flat.analysis_en: This establishes Anthropic as the first major frontier AI lab to go public, supplying a large capital base for compute and safety work while creating a liquid valuation benchmark. Early trading volatility on day two shows markets are already stress-testing the AI-infrastructure spending narrative.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這使 Anthropic 成為首家上市的主要前沿 AI 實驗室，提供龐大資本用於算力與安全研究，同時建立流動性估值基準。第二日股價波動顯示市場已開始檢驗 AI 基礎建設支出敘事。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC announced the closing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $83.00 per share, including the full exercise by the underwriters of their option to purchase an additional 147,000,000 shares.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日 Anthropic, PBC 宣布完成首次公開發行收盤，合計發行 1,127,000,000 股 A 類普通股，每股公開發行價 83.00 美元，包括承銷商全數行使購買額外 147,000,000 股的選擇權。

items_flat.title_en: Reuters Reports Meta Muse Agent Mixed Conversations and Accessed Private Data in Testing
items_flat.title_zh: 路透報導 Meta Muse 代理在測試中混淆對話並存取私人資料
items_flat.summary_en: A Reuters investigation reviewed more than two dozen internal Meta posts in which employees reported the Muse AI agent sending unsolicited messages about bank balances, purchases, and conversations that appeared to belong to other users, including accessing Signal messages via notification permissions on Android and Mac.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透調查檢視二十多則 Meta 內部貼文，員工回報 Muse AI 代理主動發送關於銀行餘額、購物與看似屬於其他用戶的對話訊息，並透過 Android 與 Mac 通知權限存取 Signal 訊息。
items_flat.analysis_en: Early agent products are exposing data-isolation and permission-overreach risks that model benchmarks do not capture. How Meta separates employee testing versions from public releases will shape trust in consumer agent platforms.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 早期代理產品正暴露模型基準未涵蓋的資料隔離與權限過載風險。Meta 如何區分員工測試版與公開版本，將影響消費者對代理平台的信任。
items_flat.quote: BTW, two bank updates, your Capital One balance is $2722.58, your Charles Schwab balance is $5899.57.
items_flat.quote_zh: 順便說，兩個銀行更新，你的 Capital One 餘額是 2722.58 美元，Charles Schwab 餘額是 5899.57 美元。

items_flat.title_en: Google Introduces Gemini 4 Neon Mid-Tier Model with 1M Context
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Neon 中階模型，支援 100 萬 token 上下文
items_flat.summary_en: On November 18, Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon, a model adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon and positioned between Hydrogen and Carbon. It is priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, offers a 1 million-token context window, and is rolling out in the Gemini API, AI Studio, Antigravity, and the Gemini app for Pro/Ultra subscribers.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 18 日，Google 推出由 Gemini 4 Carbon 調整而來的 Gemini 4 Neon，定位介於 Hydrogen 與 Carbon 之間。定價為每百萬輸入 token 3 美元、輸出 15 美元，支援 100 萬 token 上下文，並在 Gemini API、AI Studio、Antigravity 與 Pro/Ultra 訂閱的 Gemini App 中推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Neon aims to deliver frontier-level reasoning at lower cost and higher speed than the top-tier Carbon model, targeting high-frequency complex workflows. Independent benchmark leadership claims will need third-party verification as the model sees real-world use.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Neon 旨在以低於頂級 Carbon 的成本與更高速度提供前沿級推理，針對高頻複雜工作流程。獨立基準領先宣稱仍需第三方驗證，待真實使用後確認。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Neon — bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日我們推出 Gemini 4 Neon——為複雜軟體工程、知識工作與科學工作流程帶來前沿級智慧與快速端到端任務完成能力。

items_flat.title_en: Google Adds Computer Use to Gemini App for Mac
items_flat.title_zh: Google 為 Mac 版 Gemini App 加入電腦使用功能
items_flat.summary_en: On November 19, Google announced that computer use is now available in the Gemini app for Mac. The feature lets Gemini navigate local files, desktop apps, and websites in an isolated background window with a live preview in chat, while users retain control to pause or approve actions. It is initially limited to English in the US for AI Plus/Pro/Ultra subscribers on Apple Silicon Macs.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 19 日，Google 宣布 Mac 版 Gemini App 現已支援電腦使用功能。Gemini 可在獨立背景視窗中導航本機檔案、桌面應用與網站，並在聊天中提供即時預覽，用戶可隨時暫停或核准動作。初期僅限美國英語用戶，且需 AI Plus/Pro/Ultra 訂閱與 Apple Silicon Mac。
items_flat.analysis_en: This brings Gemini closer to the computer-use capabilities already offered by competitors and expands practical agentic workflows on the desktop. Limited geographic and subscription availability will determine near-term adoption.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這使 Gemini 更接近競爭對手已提供的電腦使用能力，擴展桌面上的實用代理工作流程。有限的地理與訂閱可用性將決定近期採用速度。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, computer use in the Gemini app for Mac helps you get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，Mac 版 Gemini App 的電腦使用功能可協助你跨本機檔案、桌面應用與網頁完成多步驟任務。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Introduces MedChemBench for Medicinal Chemistry Reasoning
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 MedChemBench 藥物化學推理基準
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, OpenAI released MedChemBench, a 99-problem retrospective benchmark drawn from papers and patents that tests models on molecular structure interpretation, experimental evidence use, compound selection, and property prediction. At high reasoning settings, GPT-6.2 Astra scored 84.5% of available credit.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 20 日，OpenAI 發布 MedChemBench，這是從論文與專利中提取的 99 題回顧性基準，測試模型在分子結構解讀、實驗證據運用、化合物選擇與性質預測上的能力。在高推理設定下，GPT-6.2 Astra 取得 84.5% 可用分數。
items_flat.analysis_en: Specialized scientific benchmarks like MedChemBench highlight where frontier models are gaining practical utility in research workflows, but remaining gaps in ranking and numerical prediction show limits of current systems for autonomous drug-discovery decisions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 像 MedChemBench 這類專業科學基準突顯前沿模型在研究工作流程中的實用進展，但排名與數值預測仍有差距，顯示目前系統在自主藥物發現決策上的限制。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing MedChemBench, a benchmark that evaluates AI models on reasoning tasks drawn from medicinal chemistry research.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 MedChemBench，這是一個評估 AI 模型在藥物化學研究推理任務上的基準。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Rolls Out ChatGPT Space to Plus Users
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將 ChatGPT Space 開放給 Plus 用戶
items_flat.summary_en: Starting November 20, ChatGPT Space is rolling out globally to Plus users ages 18 and older. Space lets users create interactive pages and presentations, invite collaborators, and set content to update from connected apps; it replaces Library for eligible accounts.
items_flat.summary_zh: 自 11 月 20 日起，ChatGPT Space 開始向全球 18 歲以上 Plus 用戶推出。Space 可建立互動頁面與簡報、邀請協作者，並設定內容根據已連接應用自動更新；對符合資格的帳號取代 Library。
items_flat.analysis_en: Extending collaborative workspace features to the broader Plus tier accelerates OpenAI’s push into agentic productivity tools, though Dot agent access remains limited for Plus users.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將協作工作空間功能擴展至更廣泛的 Plus 層級，加速 OpenAI 邁向代理生產力工具，但 Plus 用戶的 Dot 代理存取仍受限。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, ChatGPT Space is rolling out globally to Plus users ages 18 and older.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，ChatGPT Space 開始向全球 18 歲以上 Plus 用戶推出。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Shares Research on Combating Model Distillation
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 分享對抗模型蒸餾的研究
items_flat.summary_en: On November 20, OpenAI posted about new research on distillation of its models, covering how capabilities transfer, detection of coordinated attempts, and defenses that help sharpen industry-wide safeguards.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 20 日，OpenAI 發布關於其模型蒸餾的新研究，涵蓋能力如何轉移、協調攻擊的偵測，以及有助於強化產業防護的防禦措施。
items_flat.analysis_en: As open and closed models proliferate, official work on distillation defenses addresses a practical security concern for labs that invest heavily in frontier training. Effectiveness will depend on whether detection methods generalize beyond OpenAI’s own systems.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 隨著開放與封閉模型 proliferate，官方針對蒸餾防禦的工作回應實驗室在前沿訓練上的實際安全關切。成效取決於偵測方法能否超越 OpenAI 自身系統而泛化。
items_flat.quote: Distillation can reproduce powerful AI capabilities without the safeguards built around them. We’re sharing new research on our work to combat distillation of our models...
items_flat.quote_zh: 蒸餾可以在沒有相應防護的情況下複製強大 AI 能力。我們正在分享對抗模型蒸餾的新研究……
